ov: Two species of crepuscular rodents from the high Andes, living in colonies up to 4,270 m. They have the densest fur of any land mammal, which nearly wiped them out: wild colonies are now known only in Chile.

why.p: Domestic chinchillas, bred from the long-tailed chinchilla, are kept as pets, and most fur now comes from farms.

rg: The Andes; wild colonies are now known only in Chile.
fx: Each follicle grows about 50 hairs, around 20,000 hairs per square centimetre.
notes: Group entry (two species, both Endangered).
